notes: No HTTP library is required: the client uses the standard library and ships its own error and TLS handling.

PyMuPDF is declared because it is what lets a local file's page count be known before submission; the tool still works without it, by discovering the limit from the endpoint's own refusal and walking the file window by window.
data/ holds runtime state only (credential, ledger, runs) and is deliberately not part of the package.
